speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Besides infrastructural measures, parents and caregivers should closely monitor young children when they are near swimming pools.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: I think that is most important as well.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: SportSG has also been actively carrying out water safety outreach and education programmes to raise public awareness.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Management corporations of condominiums that also wish to participate in these programmes, or seek water safety advice in general, can also contact the management team at SportSG directly.

speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
text: Despite what has been done, we are still seeing about 10 cases over five years.

speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
text: Does the Senior Minister of State think there is something more we can do about it, for example, to include mandating some of these pool fences in private swimming pools?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: We have to balance the risks as well as the obligations that we want to put on private and public pool owners, for example, in terms of putting up barriers.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Ultimately, it is quite onerous for some of these pool owners, as the pools can be quite big in condominium developments, for example.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Private pool owners could also do so, and I think mandating could be quite difficult to implement.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The cases have to be reviewed in more detail to see what the root causes are.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But again, as I stressed earlier on, adult supervision is the most important aspect.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Of course, as they move to primary school, we do have programmes in place to ensure that our students are well educated and have greater safety awareness when they use pools and water bodies.
